links.outcome: Readability and understandability of ChatGPT-generated postoperative wound care education material
links.effect: Turkish readability index 68.9 (easily understandable); PEMAT understandability 93.90 ± 6.11; SMOG 7.89; Flesch-Kincaid 8.07; Flesch Reading Ease 59.0; Global Quality Scale 4.40 ± 0.69.
links.quote: The Turkish readability index of the education material was found to be 68.9 and easily understandable.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT 4.0 in generating patient education materials for postsurgical wound care, evaluated by experts and readability formulas.
